papers.title: Causal Abstractions of Neural Networks
findings: Section3 aligns neural representations with high-level causal variables; interchange interventions test the corresponding high- and low-level outcomes, equations1-3.
Arbitrary cross-head attention swaps do not, by themselves, establish a constructive causal abstraction. A proposed abstract variable and a corresponding intervention family are required.
limitations: Only pages1-4 read; AppendixH proof and full empirical protocol not read.
No abstraction relation for Q-RMEA was established.

papers.title: Comparison of Quantum Statistical Models: Equivalent Conditions for Sufficiency
findings: Definition19 separates statistical-morphism m-sufficiency from CPTP sufficiency.
Theorem3 relates comparison of decision problems to m-sufficiency; Proposition5 adds auxiliary models for CPTP sufficiency.
A single Macro score comparison and40 independent binary effects do not establish this decision-problem order or the ancillary conditions.
limitations: Read the identified2011 arXiv v4 preprint, not the unchecked2012 publisher text.
Only pages1,16-18 read; earlier comparison definitions and all proofs have not been fully audited. No transfer theorem is claimed.
